_comment: Sudo denials the framework has a fix for. tools/skpatch_watch.py quotes the entry (instead of 'reprovision this host') while the host's sudo coverage stamp is older than the denial; once the host is provisioned with the fix the denial resolves by itself. Keyed by dashboard action.

upgrade_package.gap: the dashboard's built-in 'upgrade selected' runs apt-get/snap with variable package names, which sudoers can never grant safely
upgrade_package.fix: skstacks PR #403 (v2.26.22): validated wrappers skpatch-apt-only-upgrade / skpatch-snap-refresh plus the default 'upgrade selected' scripts
upgrade_package.until: use Upgrade all on this host; it resolves by itself once the host is provisioned with v2.26.22
